infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PujaHop Kolkata uses your location to show nearby pandals, calculate real walking routes, and verify Puja Passport stamps.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PujaHop Kolkata uses your location for active turn-by-turn pandal navigation during your festival route.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PujaHop Kolkata uses your camera for optional photo verification when stamping your digital Puja Passport.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PujaHop Kolkata uses your photo library to save and share your branded festival trip cards.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow PujaHop to show nearby pandals and navigation.
